note: UI copy for the story screens (Earth activation, Director map, Briefing, Pre-flight). It lives beside the stage bundles because architecture section 8 puts i18n tables in content/<lang>/ and because src/engine/i18n/strings.ts is owned by the engine and its StringKey union is closed. Scene code reads these through src/game/scenes/lib/strings.ts and never inlines English.
